method: Read-only UI comparison in the in-app browser; four manual queries, no login, no account writes, no controlled latency measurement. Only outcome categories and heads were recorded; definitions and examples were not copied.
claims: This finite observation is not evidence of overall superiority to Youdao or coverage of its desktop/mobile clients.
